1.w: O Lord, the God who avenges! O God who avenges, reveal your splendor.

2.w: Rise up, O judge of the earth. Pay back the proud.

3.w: O Lord, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked celebrate?

4.w: They spew out threats and speak defiantly; all the evildoers boast.

5.w: O Lord, they crush your people; they oppress the nation that belongs to you.

6.w: They kill the widow and the resident foreigner, and they murder the fatherless.

7.w: Then they say, “The Lord does not see this; the God of Jacob does not take notice of it.”

8.w: Take notice of this, you ignorant people. You fools, when will you ever understand?

9.w: Does the one who makes the human ear not hear? Does the one who forms the human eye not see?

10.w: Does the one who disciplines the nations not punish? He is the one who imparts knowledge to human beings!

11.w: The Lord knows that peoples’ thoughts are morally bankrupt.

12.w: How blessed is the one whom you instruct, O Lord, the one whom you teach from your law

13.w: in order to protect him from times of trouble, until the wicked are destroyed.

14.w: Certainly the Lord does not forsake his people; he does not abandon the nation that belongs to him.

15.w: For justice will prevail, and all the morally upright will be vindicated.

16.w: Who will rise up to defend me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

17.w: If the Lord had not helped me, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

18.w: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” your loyal love, O Lord, supports me.

19.w: When worries threaten to overwhelm me, your soothing touch makes me happy.

20.w: Cruel rulers are not your allies, those who make oppressive laws.

21.w: They conspire against the blameless and condemn to death the innocent.

22.w: But the Lord will protect me, and my God will shelter me.

23.w: He will pay them back for their sin. He will destroy them because of their evil; the Lord our God will destroy them.
